verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Live Events debugger shows function logs, warehouse batch statuses, streaming delivery results and dead-lettered events. These can be exported as OTLP log records to Datadog or Grafana, and email/Slack notifications fire when Connector Sync or warehouse batch jobs fail or recover. That covers live watching and failure diagnosis, with partial alerting. Missing for 10: aggregated per-destination delivery metrics or dashboards, alerting on streaming (non-batch) destination delivery failures, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugger views.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting

citations.quote: Everything you can see in Live Events — function logs, warehouse batch statuses, streaming delivery results, and dead-lettered events — can now be exported to your own monitoring stack in near real time.
you’ll receive real-time Email or Slack alerts whenever a Connector Sync task or Data Warehouse Batch job fails or successfully recovers
Records are delivered as OpenTelemetry (OTLP) log records over HTTP, so they work with Datadog, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, Elastic, or any OpenTelemetry Collector.
watch Live Events in real time
